title: Warmth of the Sun Vacation Rental
meta_description: Warmth of the Sun is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionWARMTH OF THE SUNSeacrest Beach Community | 38 Endless Summer Way W, Panama City Beach, FL 32461Home Currently for SaleHome Highlights5 Bedrooms | 4.5 Bathrooms | Sleeps 11 Guests2,920 sq. ft. of indoor living | 2,100 sq. ft. of outdoor livingScreened-in porches & open-air balconies on all three levelsThird-floor sun deck with wet bar, chaise lounges, and covered porchOutdoor kitchen with DCS 30” gas grill & 24” Kamado Big Joe ceramic cookerPrivate Marquis Euphoria hot tub/spa (seats 7)Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances and gas stoveIndoor dining for 8 + 4 bar stools; outdoor dining for 6 on first-floor porchLuxurious bathrooms with Moen ioDigital vertical spa and custom closetsFlat-screen TVs with TiVo, Netflix, and Hulu throughoutLaundry room with full-size washer and dryerFour adult bikes included seasonally (Dec–Feb not included; rentals available)About the HomeDesigned for the ultimate beach getaway, Warmth of the Sun offers nearly as much outdoor living space as indoors. Relax in the private hot tub, entertain at the outdoor kitchen, or take in the sunset from the third-floor sun deck. Inside, two living areas, a spacious kitchen, and five bedrooms provide ample space for family or friends. Two king suites feature luxury en suite bathrooms: one with a walk-in shower and Moen vertical spa, the other with a whirlpool tub and separate rainfall shower. Every room flows seamlessly to outdoor spaces, perfect for relaxing or entertaining.Beach & Pool Access0.4 mile to Seacrest Beach (8-min walk or tram ride)0.2 mile to Seacrest Community Pool (4-min walk)0.5 mile to The Village of South Walton (10-min walk or 3-min bike ride)Community Amenities12,000 sq. ft. lagoon-style community pool with waterfalls, fountains, bathhouses, and lounge chairsPrivate community beach accessComplimentary tram service (March–October)Nearby top-rated dining and shopping in Seacrest, Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet BeachWalking paths and serene nature trailsNote: Golf carts and trailers are prohibited. Parking is available in a private driveway for two vehicles and nearby on-street spaces with a community pass.Reservation & PoliciesNo smokingNo pets (service animals only)50% due at booking; balance due 60 days prior (or in full if within 60 days)5% cancellation fee; initial 50% refundable if canceled more than 60 days before arrivalOptional travel insurance availableCheck-in: 6:00 PM CST (starting Jan 1, 2026 → 4:00 PM) | Check-out: 12:00 PM CST (starting Jan 1, 2026 → 10:00 AM)Guests must be 25 years or older
